description: GLM-5.3-Flash on two DGX Sparks with KindlingAI's gr8, a from-scratch CUDA inference engine (no vLLM, PyTorch or NCCL at serve time), at tensor parallel 2 over the ConnectX fabric. The weights are KindlingAI's exlr8 release at its bit349 manifest (K3 with K4 where it lowers KL most, about 3.49 bits a routed weight), int4 KV, DFlash2 speculative decoding when a request runs alone and shared-waterfill MTP=3 drafting, four requests at once (SESS=4) sharing a 2,097,152-token KV pool, a prompt cache on disk, and image input. The recipe runs the creator's published image of commit 18c948d8 (kindlingai/glm-5.3-flash-exlr8-2x-spark, gr8 4057009) with a placement wrapper that reads the platform's VONK_* environment and uses the release in place from the read-only model mounts, the DFlash2 drafter converted for each rank on its first start. Options: speed, long context (8 sessions, 1,048,576-token requests, context-parallel KV, experimental upstream) or quality (K4 width); DFlash2 or MTP only; image input; and the creator's optional compact expert copies. Creator claims, unmeasured here: 76.5 tok/s for one request writing code, 1,670 tok/s prefill at 8K, 55.1 / 70.3 / 82.9 tok/s aggregate at 1 / 2 / 4 streams, 8.9-9.2 GiB free a box after boot. Each box mounts the width files its manifests read whole (about 255 GB), where the creator's launcher range-fetches about 77 GB from Hugging Face. Thinking is always on in GLM 5.3's template: a request that turns it off gets HTTP 400 (the creator's default), and a small max_tokens can end inside the thinking. Licences, for information: the weights and engine are MIT (Z.AI's notice kept); the DFlash2 drafter is CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 (non-commercial).
title: GLM 5.3 Flash EXLR8 gr8 two Sparks
